				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: projected route income" * "cf: mining frontier ships" / 9
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: mining frontier daily crew"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: trading local trip payout" * "cf: trading local ships" / 4
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: trading local daily expenses"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: trading regional trip payout" * "cf: trading regional ships" / 6
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: trading regional daily expenses"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: trading long trip payout" * "cf: trading long ships" / 8
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: trading long daily expenses"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: trading frontier trip payout" * "cf: trading frontier ships" / 10
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: trading frontier daily expenses"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: security local trip payout" * "cf: security local ships" / 4
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: security local daily crew"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: security regional trip payout" * "cf: security regional ships" / 6
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: security regional daily crew"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: security long trip payout" * "cf: security long ships" / 8
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: security long daily crew"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: security frontier trip payout" * "cf: security frontier ships" / 10
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: security frontier daily crew"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: admiral tribute income"
				"cf: projected gross" += "cf: station daily income"
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: admiral daily crew"
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: security admiral" * 20000
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: managed" * 10000
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: station daily upkeep"
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: office daily cost"
				"cf: projected expenses" += "cf: hq daily tax"
				"cf: projected net" = "cf: projected gross" - "cf: projected expenses"
				"cf: projected owner payout" = "cf: projected net" * "cf: payout share" / 100
				"cf: projected owner payout" >?= 0
				"cf: projected retained" = "cf: projected net" - "cf: projected owner payout"
				"cf: projected autopay net" = "cf: projected owner payout"
			`Transaction confirmed. Your clerks update the company board before you sign the receipt.`
			`	Updated outlook: reserve &[credits@cf: reserve], daily taxes &[credits@cf: hq daily tax], expected daily gross &[credits@cf: projected gross], expected daily expenses &[credits@cf: projected expenses], expected daily net &[credits@cf: projected net].`
			`	At the current payout share, a positive operating day would queue about &[credits@cf: projected owner payout] for direct AutoPay and leave about &[credits@cf: projected retained] in company reserve.`
			`	AutoPay estimate: about &[credits@cf: projected autopay net] would reach your account with no transfer fee or tax deduction.`
				to display
					has "cf: autopay"
			choice
				`	Return to the company board.`
					goto "company main menu"
			label "confirm sell company"
			`Sell the entire company for the currently calculated firm value of &[credits@cf: company value]? This closes every active company division.`
			choice
				`	Sell company.`
					goto "start company sale"
				`	Cancel.`
					goto "company main menu"

				"cf: company value" = "cf: reserve"

				"cf: company value" += "cf: station daily income" * 365
				"cf: company value" >?= 0
				"cf: sale proceeds" = "cf: company value"
				"cf: sale remaining" = "cf: company value"

				goto "company sale payout"

				`	Collect 1.000.000.000 credits.`

					goto "collect sale 10000000"
				`	Collect 1.000.000 credits.`
